title: InterHier: Learning Interconnected Hierarchical Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.24026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the limitations of fixed, hand-crafted connectors in hierarchical semantic representations for open-vocabulary object detection. Existing methods establish semantic relationships between base categories and unseen novel categories by placing a fixed connector between adjacent super-/sub-categories. However, such fixed connectors may not optimally capture the relationships within a semantic hierarchy. To address this limitation, we propose interconnected hierarchical semantic representations (InterHier), which utilize a prepended learnable context to globally guide the interpretation of prompts containing hierarchical relationships. InterHier operates in two main stages. First, it constructs a hierarchy-aware prompt by integrating super-/sub-categories and prepending a learnable context. translated_title: InterHier：面向开放词汇目标检测的互联层次语义学习
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了开放词汇目标检测中层次语义表示里固定的、手工设计连接器的局限性。现有方法通过在相邻的父类/子类之间放置固定连接器，来建立基础类别与未见新类别之间的语义关系。然而，这种固定连接器可能无法最优地捕捉语义层次内部的关系。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了互联层次语义表示，它利用前置的可学习上下文来全局引导对包含层次关系的提示的解读。InterHier 主要在两个阶段运行：首先，通过整合父类/子类并前置一个可学习上下文来构建层次感知提示；其次，优化该可学习上下文以对齐视觉区域嵌入和文本嵌入。
tldr: 提出InterHier方法，用前置的可学习上下文替代固定连接器来全局引导层次语义提示的解读，从而更好地对齐视觉与文本嵌入，提升开放词汇目标检测对新类别的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: InterHier replaces fixed hand-crafted connectors with a prepended learnable context that globally guides the interpretation of hierarchy-aware prompts, better aligning visual and textual embeddings to improve open-vocabulary object detection on novel categories.
